Subject: New pilot — payment & PO process question

Hi Kimberly,

We're excited to move forward with the 90-day pilot of Redwood for our analytics ingest. Procurement asked whether a formal PO will be required for the initial pilot — they prefer to issue invoices and handle payment after each milestone rather than open a PO for a short trial. Can you confirm Redwood's policy on pilots under $15k?

If a PO is mandatory, please let us know the quickest path to provision one; if an invoice-only route is acceptable, what evidence (SOW, onboarding form, billing contact) do you need from our side?

Attaching our internal billing contact and the proposed SOW draft (for your review).

Thanks,

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: we can make a limited invoice-only exception for short pilots in specific circumstances, but Finance needs minimal artifacts and an approved exception.

What we need from LedgerFlow to evaluate the exception:
- Completed vendor_onboarding_form (standard Redwood vendor intake)
- Final SOW or statement of work that defines pilot scope, dates, and acceptance criteria
- Billing contact and invoice email

I attached our vendor onboarding form; if you can return that plus the edited SOW, I'll route to Finance and Sales Ops. Copying Ben (Finance) to confirm thresholds and Marissa (Sales) for the commercial sign-off.

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 82KB)

Best,
Kimberly Park

kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: New pilot — payment & PO process question

Kim / Marissa — quick finance read:
- We can approve invoice-only for pilots up to $15,000 total for up to 90 days, provided we receive the vendor onboarding form and a signed SOW that includes billing cadence and acceptance criteria.
- Require a billing contact + remit-to email and confirmation there is no procurement embargo (i.e., they won't retroactively demand a PO for the pilot period).
- Legal should review any non-standard indemnities, but for a short pilot we can accept our standard T&Cs (no enterprise addenda).

If they meet the artifacts above, Finance will log an exception (exp-2026-1103) and allow invoice-only path. I recommend adding a clause in the SOW: \"Pilot payments are invoice-based; LedgerFlow confirms no PO requirement for pilot term.\" That protects both parties.

I'll approve once we receive vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and the finalized SOW.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

Ethan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for returning the onboarding form and updated SOW.

Finance has approved a temporary invoice-only exception for the 90-day pilot under deal DL-8421, capped at $15,000. Conditions:
1) Redwood receives the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and the signed SOW (SOW_LedgerFlow_v1.docx).
2) LedgerFlow confirms billing contact and remit-to email on invoices.
3) Pilot invoices must be labeled with the deal id (DL-8421) and reference this exception request (exp-2026-1103).
4) If procurement requests a PO later, LedgerFlow must notify Redwood and we will evaluate converting to a PO-based flow for subsequent work.

Please sign the SOW via DocuSign here to complete the exception: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/signed/abc1234

Attachments included: SOW_LedgerFlow_v1.docx (DOCX, 58KB), vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 82KB).

Once signed, Sales Ops will create the supplier record and Finance will permit invoice submission per the terms above. Looking forward to getting you onto Dedicated test capacity next week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
